releases.displayName: Stray Souls Demo - New Update Available

items.text: We’re back! The team at Jukai Studio have been working hard on another small update to improve the demo experience for you.

notes.title: Here’s a list of what has been changed in the latest update

items.text: Fixed a bug where Daniel could reach a secondary checkpoint before Martha and trigger an out of sequence event.
Daniel can now pick up ammo while still holding the gun. The weapon will no longer auto-holster.
Daniel can now reload the gun while aiming.
Improved Daniel’s visual grip on the gun to look more natural.
Daniel can now break out of the stun lock animation by dodge rolling.
Fixed a bug where the Sprint function wasn’t working when the button was pressed.
Toned down Martha’s reaction animations when getting bumped to feel more natural.
Fixed a visual bug where Martha appeared to get dragged through the door frame.
Our sincerest thanks once again to everyone who has played the demo and shared your feedback with us! Please keep it coming.
We hope you’re enjoying your time in Aspen Falls. Be sure to download the update and give it a spin!
Hey, everyone!
We’d like to say thanks again for playing our new Stray Souls demo and taking the time to tell us about it.
We heard you loud and clear, and we’re excited to share that we’ve already made some adjustments to improve your experience.
The Glutton’s HP has been reduced.
The Glutton’s “vomit” attack now has a longer cooldown period.
Daniel’s dodge roll has been adjusted and now works better to avoid taking damage.
Added a UI pop-up when picking up ammo from crates to show how many bullets were actually taken.
We’re continuing to review feedback and plan out adjustments for future demo updates, so please keep it coming - we appreciate it very much!

There’s been so much excitement and enthusiasm around Stray Souls since we first announced the title – we couldn’t resist the opportunity to catch up with our developer team, Jukai Studio, to provide our community with a progress update!

notes.title: Where We're At - And What's Next!

items.text: Hello everyone!

We would like to provide you with an update on the current status of Stray Souls and share a glimpse into what’s been happening here at Jukai Studio. We’re excited to announce that the game is now fully playable from beginning to end – and we’re extremely pleased with how the overall experience is shaping up!
Although we still have some polishing left to do, we’re thrilled to have come this far and can’t wait for you all to get your hands on it!
Over the past few months, we’ve added a plethora of exciting features to Stray Souls to enhance the gameplay experience. One of the latest additions is...
Continue reading here!
We've decided to add some additional system improvements, character movement, player guidance, and a few other minor tweaks.
Here is your full breakdown on what the new Stray Souls demo update fixed, changed and improved:
Added input mapping to the pause menu, since some of you didn't knew which button to use.
Reworked gameplay camera to be more cinematic and previously it made some gameplay moments very difficult, especially in combat when camera was clipping with other objects. It's fixed now.
Improved movement system so now it's way more fluid and responsive.
Added new objective system so know you can press a button to check your current objective.
Changed blood vfx.
Fixed aiming bug.
We're proud to inform you that in this update from now on, you can move character while aiming with a gun! We know that many of you wanted this feature, so we decided to add it immediately.
Here is your full breakdown on what the new Stray Souls demo update fixed, changed and improved:
From now on while you are in aiming mode, you can move the character.
Disabled SteamVR plugin which prevented some of us from opening up the game in correct way.
Rewritten code for turning a character's head. From now on, it does not rotate it in a strange way, but in the correct natural looking way.
Removed one barrier which sometimes caused AI enemies to block on it.
Another update that introduces huge gameplay improvements and fixes a number of bugs that ruined gameplay before.
Here is your full breakdown on what the new Stray Souls demo update fixed, changed and improved:
Highlighting the first note, as many people said it was hard to see.
Reseting the camera position when exiting from the inspection viewport.

Improvied weapon system, previously when we tried to aim too fast with a gun it would sometimes generate a strange bug. The code has been rewritten and enhanced so that this bug no longer occurs. Additionally, we have added a new animation when not aiming a weapon to add immersion.
Objective to look around with the camera to find a key has been improved, cause many people missed it and wasn't able to find it.
Fixed the ravens system, before they would block on objects collision or stop flying in air which created a strange bug and ruined immersion. We've rewritten their code and now the old bugs are gone.
We reworked the interaction system with shopping carts from scratch because they generated a lot of bugs, including those that blocked characters and progress. It's fixed.

At the lever puzzle, people were confusing which doors have been unlocked. We have reworked the model so that now there is no doubt that the lever puzzle does not unlock the door in the electrical station but the one that are outside.
We added sway while aiming with a gun.
Improved motion matching movement system, the character should no longer make strange buggy steps.
Replaced idle animation, twisted fingers and strange glitchy arm gestures are gone.
Martyr Worms collision was corrected, from now on the character does not collide with them and cannot walk on them.
Fixed interaction icon for the first ranger car.
Added collisions to some missing objects.
Added some missing blocking collisions on the playground.
Removed foliage interfering and colliding with some objects.
We have selected the most frequent feedbacks we got from you and decided to fix them right away which is the day after we released demo!

notes.title: Here is your full breakdown on what those fixes includes

items.text: Fixed collisions on ranger cars
Added hints when you can't interact with something yet
Added hints regarding unequipping weapon to interact with other objects/things
fixed getting stuck in one of the shopping carts
Rewrited some hints to help with tasks navigation
Redesigned lever puzzle so it really is a puzzle to solve, not just guessing
